schema: custom raw ABI read from the experimental Rust source at commit 380a54d. Not a generated Anchor IDL. The sbf build does not emit one.
deliberate_incompatibility: Shared crank_pay_page_v3 has 10 named accounts. The current caller sends 9. The tenth is the writable quote reserve. Per-pool has those same 9 and no reserve.

crank_claim_damm has 18 named accounts on both designs, then 5 creator extras, then one design account: quote reserve on shared, pool vault on per-pool. A caller that stops at 18+5 is short one account.
crank_auto_lp has no named accounts. Shared and per-pool tails differ after the two QuoteStats.
Per-pool pay, burn, and release require the quote vault owner to be the pool record. Shared requires the global ATA.
check_quote_mint is a simulate-only crank gate. close_old_checkpoints is a separate maintenance send. Neither is a website instruction, and neither is unused.

errors.numbering: Anchor starts at 6000. The two programs share codes through 6049. From 6050 the variants differ.

mint_policy.check_quote_mint_return: 7 bytes: tier u8, decimals u8, is_token_2022 u8, flags u32 le
mint_policy.tier_1_if_any_of: freeze authority, permanent delegate, pausable, hook authority, transfer fee, default account state. Tier 1 does not by itself reject the mint.

rejects.when: mint owner is not Tokenkeg or Token-2022
mint data shorter than 82, initialized flag not 1, or a Token-2022 TLV entry is truncated
decimals above 18, the Token-2022 wSOL mint, NonTransferable, or ConfidentialMintBurn
TransferHook program id is not all zeros
Pausable extension paused byte is not 0
current or scheduled transfer fee is above 100 bps

mint_policy.caller: The crank pair check builds this instruction and simulates it. It is not a website send. A successful simulation is the gate; a rejecting error suspends the pair.

check_quote_mint_and_close_old_checkpoin: The crank simulates check_quote_mint before a pair is allowed. close_old_checkpoints is sent by its own maintenance command. The earlier handoff sentence that called them unused is wrong.
